m-jacksonville|2024-09-03|6dcae71f|f11c5.title:
AMENDMENT
1. Reflect that legislation is granting approval to submit a loan application to HUD and that approval of any future related loan shall be subject to appropriation by City Council 
2. Attach Revised Exhibit 1 (Loan Application) to correct amortization schedules and pro forma


• City previously approved a 40-year lease of Armory 
• Loan funding would be eligible to go towards the $20,000,000 funding commitment required by December 2024
